name: Kota: The Survival
storyline:
Introduction: The Graveyard of Concrete and Metal
Humanity brought about its own demise through hyper-industrialization, ecological collapse, and resource wars. Their only remaining legacy is a toxic atmosphere, barren soil, and mountains of metal, plastic, and electronic waste. Decades after the disappearance of humans, a prototype restoration robot named KOTA triggers its reactivation protocol in an abandoned industrial facility.

Development: Architecture of Nature
KOTA’s core programming is directed toward a single primary directive: Restore the Planet.

Scavenging & Upgrading: KOTA gathers the remnants of the old civilization (scrap, batteries, microchips) to upgrade its own systems and build small bases that generate clean energy.

Purifying the Earth: It constructs specialized filtration structures to neutralize toxic chemicals and purify the parched soil, planting the very first saplings.

Mechanical Threats: KOTA is not alone. Malfunctioning, territorial security and mining robots left behind by humanity view the newly blooming green zones—and KOTA itself—as a threat. KOTA must fight these corrupted machines to protect the reviving environment.

Climax & Resolution: A Green Future
As KOTA systematically converts wasteland into thriving green ecosystems, it uncovers data logs and voice recordings revealing the final days of humanity. The story highlights not just a robot’s survival, but a journey of using technology—the very force that once destroyed the world—to bring it back to life.
summary: KOTA: The Survival is a post-apocalyptic sandbox survival and re-greening game. Control a restoration robot, scavenge human waste to upgrade, fight corrupted machines, and bring life back to a barren world.
